title: US Forces Seize Maduro in Caracas and Fly Him to New York
dek: Before dawn on 3 January 2026, US aircraft and Delta Force raid Caracas and seize Nicolás Maduro; his deputy keeps the government, and Washington takes charge of the oil money.
body: About 150 aircraft and half an hour of strikes. Maduro's trial in New York is set for June 2027.

panels.label: Trump Said
panels.text: Trump said the US would “run the country until such time as we can do a safe, proper and judicious transition.”

panels.label: Rodríguez Said
panels.text: Delcy Rodríguez called the raid an “illegal and illegitimate kidnapping” and said Venezuela would “never again be a colony of any empire.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Both sides speak of law; at stake is who controls the world’s largest proven oil reserves, and whether Washington may remove a leader in its hemisphere alone.
